card.name: Verbs and prepositions before 'all/various' ranges
card.fires_on: A verb or small linking word right after a plural noun, where the next words are likely to be 'all', 'various', 'a variety of' or 'every'. It marks a statement about something occurring across a wide range.

modes.label: Linking word before a range
modes.description: 'of' or 'at' placed after a noun, leading into 'all kinds' or 'various' items.
modes.example: They eat food<< of>> all kinds and may hitchhike into

modes.label: Reporting or location verb
modes.description: A verb such as reported, diagnosed, located or represented after a plural subject, before a spread of places or types.
modes.example: but people are<< diagnosed>> in all 50 states.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'every' or 'everything', such as 'every' and 'everywhere'.
card.plain: It fires where a sentence is about to say something happens in all places, at all times or in all kinds.
